description: Mesures de signal 4-ops 4G is a series of datasets listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Opendata de Grand Paris Sud. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal shows 4,988 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-12-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
